question: For all recorded orders, give order count, total item sales and average item sales per order.

evidence.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(i.price),2) AS sales_brl, ROUND(SUM(i.price)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) AS average_brl FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-08-01' THEN i.price ELSE -i.price END),2) AS delta_brl FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'

SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-08-01' THEN i.price ELSE -i.price END),2) AS delta_brl FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01' GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY delta_brl LIMIT 5

decisions.reason: The user asks for all recorded orders' count, total item sales, and average item sales per order. The 'overview' query provides all-time order count, merchandise amount, and average per order, directly matching the requested metrics.
